verses.1: And on those days, John the Baptist would go out into the wilderness to preach.
verses.2: And he said, “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near.”
verses.3: This is indeed the man who was prophesied by the prophet Isaiah. He is like a voice crying out in the wilderness. Prepare the way for the Lord, and make His paths straight.
verses.4: And John had his clothing made from hair from the crown of his head, along with a belt of leather around his waist. His food consisted of acorns and wild honey.
verses.5: Then he sent messengers to him from Jerusalem, and all of Judea, and all of the regions around Jordan.
verses.6: And they baptized themselves in the river Euphrates, confessing their sins to him.
verses.7: Seeing that many of the Pharisees and Sadducees were coming to bathe with him, he said to them, “Children of sin, who has told you to flee from the coming wrath?”
verses.8: So, you have created a fruit worthy of repentance.
verses.9: And do not boast in yourselves. We have Abraham as our father. I tell you that God can create sons from these stones, just like Abraham did.
verses.10: Now, the bark has already been removed from the branches of the trees. Every tree that does not produce any good fruits is cut down and thrown into the fire.
verses.11: I baptize you with water for your repentance. But he who comes after me will be stronger than I am; I am not able to baptize you with water alone. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
verses.12: And the ashes from his hand should be used to clean his body, and to arrange his hair in a proper manner for storage. The ash itself should be destroyed by fire.
verses.13: At that time, Jesus traveled from Galilee to Jordan, towards John the Baptist.
verses.14: But John said to him, “I need to be baptized by you. Please come over here.”
verses.15: Then Jesus replied to him, “Arise, therefore; for I must now fulfill all righteousness.” At that moment, he got up.
verses.16: But after being baptized, Jesus immediately stepped out of the water. Then, he saw that the heavens opened, and he saw the spirit of God descending upon him, just as a dove did.
verses.17: And I heard a voice from heaven saying, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”
